name: NATO's ground forces against Pannonia: an allied corps
status: F3.1 (21 Nov 2026): data only (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 11). Nothing reads it on the campaign path until F3.3; simcore/ground_war/ground_data.hpp loads it and tests/test_ground_data.cpp checks it.
source: a corps of three divisions and a cavalry regiment (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 3.1); doctrine from fm_100_5_1976, fm_100_5_1982, fm_71_100_1978, clark_1954_oro and hero_1982_termination (docs/research/fronts_2026-11/nato_ground.md); NATO's own frontages are SAM3D estimates (no period manual gives them); the brigades' equipment placeholders; the invasion of Pannonia is the game's fiction and its plan a SAM3D estimate
notes: Two US-pattern divisions (one armoured, one mechanised on older equipment) and a German-pattern armoured division, with an armoured cavalry regiment as the covering force and the corps' artillery. Numbers are placeholders as the factions' aircraft are. Equipment types are the strength weights' ids (data/gameplay/ground_war.json); no basic models yet (F5.2).

attack_ratio.source: fm_100_5_1976 pp. 3-4, 3-5: 3:1 or better in the sector

breakthrough_ratio.source: fm_100_5_1976 pp. 3-4, 3-5: seeks 6:1 at the point of decision

withdraw_needs_order.source: hero_1982_termination: battles end on the mission; a NATO commander stops his attack on his own losses (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 5.3)

counterattack_by_senior.source: estimate (SAM3D): NATO's divisions decide their own counterattacks within the corps' plan (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 5.3)

second_echelon_to_success.source: estimate (SAM3D): no Soviet-style echelons; the corps commits its reserve where its commander judges (fm_100_5_1982 ch. 8 on the offence)

covering_force_share.source: fm_71_100_1978 p. 5-13; fm_101_10_1_1976 p. 7-16: 30-50% of a division's manoeuvre units

attack_stop_losses.source: estimate (SAM3D) within clark_1954_oro's ranges by mission and hero_1982_termination: an attack stops at 15-35% cumulative losses, drawn per unit

defence_break_losses.source: estimate (SAM3D) within clark_1954_oro's ranges by mission: a defence breaks at 25-50% cumulative losses, drawn per unit

breakthrough.source: estimate (SAM3D): no NATO norm for a deliberate attack's day; as the Pact's 25-30 (the HERO rates set the pace below it)

depth.source: fm_100_5_1982 p. 8-7: corps and division operations may cover 50-80 km daily (its low end short of an exploitation)

broken.source: fm_100_5_1982 p. 8-7: 50-80 km daily in an exploitation

fscl.notes: The corps' fire support coordination line (F3.7, docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 6): drawn per sector on a terrain line, close air support short of it, air interdiction beyond. The sources disagree on its depth (FM 6-20: as close to the forward troops as the situation allows; OTA on FOFA: about 30 km); the defence's band is the research's reading (docs/research/fronts_2026-11/nato_ground.md ctl-02 to ctl-04). In attack it is the next terrain line beyond the day's objective (the day's objective: the axis's depth and a day at its breakthrough cap, short of its objective); the model's terrain lines are the rivers its route crosses, looked for within terrain_reach_km beyond, else the defence's middle beyond the day's objective. C2's mission label reads it in place of c2.bai_depth_m.

defence_km.source: fm_101_5_1_1980 p. 1-49 (set by corps on terrain seen from the air); ota_1987_fofa pp. 78-79 (about 30 km in FOFA planning); fm_6_20_1977 p. D-5 (as close as the situation allows): 20-30 km beyond the FLOT in defence, the middle used

terrain_reach_km.source: estimate (SAM3D): the next terrain line beyond the day's objective is looked for this far (fm_6_20_1977 ch. 4: in a fluid attack the FSCL is kept well forward)

frontages_km.source: estimate (SAM3D) bounded by fm_100_5_1976 p. 5-3 (6-8 battalions on one fifth of a division's front); no period manual gives NATO's own
estimate (SAM3D): a main attack brigade (nato_ground.md section 3)

start_after_h.source: SAM3D estimate: the owner's open decision 3 taken as proposed (docs/fronts/README.md): NATO's corps attacks after a few days of the air force's rollback

plan.source: SAM3D estimate: the axes and objectives are the game's fiction on the country map; depth in hours by fm_100_5_1982 p. 6-2 (the corps' area of influence 72 h)
plan.notes: The main attack along the western road through Kisvar to Novo Varosd and the industrial belt with two divisions, the cavalry regiment covering it; a supporting attack south of the Lenta towards Saldanj. No Soviet-style second echelon: each division keeps a brigade back as its own reserve, its commander's to commit.
